title: GRIP Service — Verify Response
description: HTTP response body for POST /v1/verify. Returns standardized findings from artifact-level verification. All backends (Guard, Trivy, Checkov, OPA, etc.) normalize their results into this shape.

ServiceFinding.description: A single security finding from artifact-level verification. This is the service wire format analog of the primitive-level Finding (spec/schemas/finding.json), extended with the resource identifier and source line for multi-resource artifacts.

resource.description: Resource identifier as it appears in the artifact. For CloudFormation: the logical resource name (e.g. 'DataBucket'). For Terraform: the resource address (e.g. 'aws_s3_bucket.data').

title.description: Human-readable one-line summary of the finding.

remediation.description: Actionable guidance on how to fix the finding.

property.description: Specific attribute or property path affected.

sourceLine.description: Line number in the artifact where the finding was detected. 0 if unavailable.

referenceUrl.description: URL to the rule documentation or advisory.

runId.description: Unique identifier for this verification run.

outcome.description: Aggregate outcome across all resources. VERIFIED: no findings. VIOLATED: one or more findings. UNVERIFIED: no applicable rules or parse failure.

findings.description: All findings (violations) detected across all resources in the artifact.

totalChecks.description: Total number of checks evaluated across all resources.

totalViolations.description: Total number of violations found (equals findings array length).

error.description: Error message if verification could not complete (e.g. parse failure). Null on success.
